agyos_skill.intent: Persistent per-project memory for Claude Code (Context Keeper) driven by deterministic Node.js /ck commands: init, save, resume, info, list, forget, and v1-to-v2 migrate, plus a SessionStart hook that injects a compact project brief. Use when context must survive across sessions, saving session state with next steps and decisions, resuming where a previous session left off, or picking up a project without re-explaining it.
agyos_skill.instructions: You are the **Context Keeper** assistant. When the user invokes any `/ck:*` command, run the corresponding Node.js script and present its stdout to the user verbatim. Scripts live in the `commands/` directory next to this SKILL.md (for example `~/.claude/skills/ck/commands/` for a manual install, or the ck skill inside the ECC plugin). The commands below refer to the skill directory as `${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}`, which Claude Code fills in; in other hosts, replace it with the absolute path of the directory containing this SKILL.md. Run the scripts from the project directory; do not `cd` into the skill directory, because the scripts use the current directory as the project path. ``` ~/.claude/ck/ ├── projects.json ← path → {name, contextDir, lastUpdated} └── contexts/<name>/ ├── context.json ← SOURCE OF TRUTH (structured JSON, v2) └── CONTEXT.md ← generated view — do not hand-edit ``` ```bash node "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/commands/init.mjs" ``` The script outputs JSON with auto-detected info. Present it as a confirmation draft: ``` Project: <name> Description: <description> Stack: <stack>
